messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@horizon-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Interested in Dedicated - throughput questions

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the self-serve and started running some evals against the hosted endpoints. Our infra lead (cc'd) wants to evaluate Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and tail-latency. Would love to schedule a 30-45m demo to walk through Dedicated, throughput / latency guarantees, and what your benchmarking looks like.

High-level requirements from our side:
- Peak QPS ~60 (spiky traffic), average concurrent requests ~20
- Typical request size ~512 tokens; some heavy jobs up to 2k tokens
- Goal: 95th percentile latency <300ms for 512-token requests, and predictable throughput for batch workloads (tokens/sec target ~30k)

Can you do something next week? We're West Coast (PST). Happy to share a short CSV with our sample workload.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Platform
Horizon AI
sofia@horizon-ai.com

Attachment: benchmark-stats.csv (CSV stub)

Quick questions so we tailor the session:
- Do you want a high-level product walkthrough + Q&A or a technical deep-dive with an SE present?
- Can you share a sample prompt set (or the CSV you mentioned) so we can size a representative dedicated node?
- Any compliance/network requirements for Private deployment vs Hosted?

I can do 30-45m next week on: Tue 4/13 10:00-11:00 PST, Wed 4/14 14:00-15:00 PST, or Thu 4/15 09:30-10:15 PST. If those don't work, send a time that does and I can loop in our SE.

I'll cc Aditya (solutions) to join a technical deep-dive; looping in Lauren from CS for post-demo onboarding notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole

- 5m quick intros & current infra

Thanks for the heads up, Marissa - I'll be on the call Wed 4/14 and will bring a focused benchmarking plan. Quick notes so we run the demo to match their expectations:

- We'll show a short perf test for 512-token requests and a higher-token test (2k) to show latency curves.
- For the 95th <300ms target on 512 tokens: we'll demonstrate a dedicated node with continuous batching disabled for low-latency, kernel selection tuned, and suggestion to use int8 quantization on compatible models. We'll also show KV cache behavior for multi-turn workloads.
- For sustained token throughput (~30k tokens/sec): we'll prepare a batch-run demo (offline) and share aggregated token/sec numbers and cost profile.

Pre-demo checklist attached: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
Please drop the prompt set or a sanitized workload to redwood-shared (link above) so we can pre-run a baseline before Wed.

See you on Wed - I'll create a short benchmarking doc and share slides beforehand.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
